claims.disposition: Answered from source: dynamically, from a file, never an environment variable. load_baseline (194-200) reads <workspace_root>/scripts/baselines/capsule_runtime_health.json via serde_json. Line 31 wraps it in unwrap_or_default(), so an absent or unparseable file is indistinguishable from an empty whitelist.
